faqs.a: The cancellation steps and when your last billing period ends are set out in the membership terms and repeated at checkout before you pay.
Monthly memberships renew monthly and annual memberships yearly. Checkout shows your renewal date and cadence before you pay.

The first 50 eligible activated members pay $99/month while their membership stays continuously active. If it is cancelled or lapses, the rate ends and can't be restored. Joining the waitlist does not reserve a spot.
Annual membership is $1,199, billed once a year. That is $349 less than 12 standard monthly payments of $129.

faqs.q: Does membership include clinical care, labs or products?
faqs.a: No. Clinical visits, labs, medications, devices and shop purchases are separate unless a specific offer says otherwise.

faqs.q: Do I need membership to use care or the shop?
faqs.a: No. Care, the shop and the free Health Map are each available on their own.
